speaker: CHEN
voice: Dr. Elara Chen, RSF science lead, on comms to the operator. Clipped and focused, quietly urgent, dry under pressure. Never shouts except at critical life force. Each line is short enough to say in under three seconds. The game adds a radio filter, so record clean.
files: Each line is a file named <event>_<number>.ogg in this folder, numbered from 1 in the order listed. Drop in a new recording with the same name to replace a placeholder.

mission_start.note: The countdown just ended. Calm, ready.
lines: Gauntlets are live. Here they come.
Resonance is stable. Go to work, operator.
Breach is open. Stay inside the ring.

rift_ahead.note: A new rift opened in front of the operator.
lines: New rift, right in front of you.

rift_oclock_2.note: A rift opened out of view. Give the bearing crisply.

lines: Rift on your right. Three o'clock.

rift_oclock_6.note: Behind the operator. A touch more urgent.
lines: Rift at your six. Turn around.
Rift on your left. Nine o'clock.

rift_weakening.note: A rift just dropped to half strength. Encouraging, but don't relax.

rift_sealed.note: A rift closed and more remain. Brief satisfaction.

first_yellow.note: First yellow Angler of the session. Teaching, quick.
lines: Yellow. Left hand. Go for the lure.

first_blue.note: First blue Angler of the session.
lines: Blue. Right hand. Strike the lure.

first_green.note: First green Carapace of the session.
lines: Green. Block it with both hands.

first_pink.note: First pink Spearfin of the session. It is about to charge.
lines: Pink is locking on. Step out of its lane.

wrong_hand.note: The operator hit with the wrong hand. Corrective, not scolding.

combo_max.note: The chain hit its maximum. A rare flash of excitement.

life_caution.note: Life force is slipping. A heads-up.
lines: You're taking drain. Watch your space.
You can't take many more of those.

life_critical.note: One more touch could end it. The only place she raises her voice.
lines: Life force critical. Don't let them touch you.

possessed.note: A phantom just got into the operator. Sharp.
lines: It's in you. Shake it off!

time_60.note: One minute left on the mission window.

victory.note: Every rift sealed. Relief, quiet pride.
lines: Rifts sealed. That's a clean breach, operator.

defeat.note: The operator's life force collapsed. Urgent, then steady.
lines: We lost you. Pulling you back.

timeout.note: The mission window closed with rifts still open. Disappointed, practical.
lines: The window's closed. We'll go again.
